title: Rory and the Hollow of Stars
verses:
The sun had gone down over valley and crest,
When Rory stepped out in the darkening cool.
The birds in the branches were flying to rest,
And shadows stretched long on the glittering pool.

High up in the sky, Nia circled the trees,
While Psittaco chirped from a nest in the bark.
A sweet scent of pine drifted in with the breeze,
To guide all the friends through the velvet and dark.

Then Ricky zipped past with a leap and a bound,
To clear off a path over branches and moss.
And Tilly walked slow as she stepped on the ground,
To show where the stream was quite easy to cross.

Then Benny stretched out in a hollow of reed,
Where silver light shone from the stars overhead.
And Rory decided that this was indeed,
The coziest spot for a wilderness bed.

Now Psittaco snuggled right under a wing,
As Nia tucked close to the rest of the crew.
The night insects started so softly to sing,
Beneath a calm ceiling of violet and blue.

Now Rory yawned wide as he shut his tired eyes,
And Ricky let out a small sigh of delight.
Soft moonbeams came down from the shimmering skies,
To whisper sweet dreams to the forest tonight.
